admission_rule.metric: min over ALL executable member solo full-window J values minus group J; no zero floor
admission_rule.window: original source group receipt window on every branch, with preserved t0 action and strictly post-t0 intervention
admission_rule.uncertainty: 2000 paired circular block draws, 30-second blocks, RNG 20261103; best full-window solo reselected each draw
admission_rule.CI: two-sided percentile CI95; pooled equal-seed mean and each seed lower bound must be strictly > 0
admission_rule.physical_effect: at least two actual actors simultaneously change issued safe commands by more than 1e-6 m/s^2 on each seed; raw/library/safe deltas cross-checked
admission_rule.safety: existing MAIN04:26 group-minus-base composite rule plus zero collisions/teleports on all branches; missing counters fail closed
admission_rule.diagnostics: negative, zero, uncertain, unsafe, non-executing, incomplete and mismatched receipts retained as diagnostic-only
admission_rule.reporting: total benefit and group-over-best-solo synergy reported separately; within-context bounds are not generalization intervals
